kw: a unit of power equal to 1000 watts
kw-hr: a unit of energy equal to the work done by a power of 1000 watts operating for one hour
kwa: a group of African language in the Niger-Congo group spoken from the Ivory Coast east to Nigeria
kwacha: the basic unit of money in Zambia
the basic unit of money in Malawi
kwai: the basic unit of money in China
kwajalein: an atoll in the western Marshall Islands that was used as a Japanese air and naval base during World War II
an amphibious assault in the Pacific in World War II (January 1944)
kwakiutl: a member of the Wakashan people living around Queen Charlotte Sound and on northern Vancouver Island
a Wakashan language spoken by the Kwakiutl
kwangchow: a city on the Zhu Jiang delta in southern China
kwannon: Japanese counterpart of Chinese Kuan Yin
kwanza: the basic unit of money in Angola
kwashiorkor: severe malnutrition in children resulting from a diet excessively high in carbohydrates and low in protein
kwazulu-natal: a region of eastern South Africa on the Indian Ocean
kweek: trailing grass native to Europe now cosmopolitan in warm regions
kwela: a kind of danceable music popular among black South Africans
kwell: a preparation of lindane (trade name Kwell) that is used to kill lice and itch mites
